mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a shift toward accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.25% triggers a flight to quality in equities, as investors anticipate higher future rates and reduce exposure to rate-sensitive assets, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to increase investment in productive capacity and raising expected equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs indicates weakening demand, prompting firms to reduce investment and lowering expected equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above 95.0 signals accelerating supply-side capacity, reducing near-term inflationary pressures and prompting central banks to hold rates steady, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in supply-side expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below 90.0 signals supply-side contraction, raising inflationary pressures and prompting central banks to raise rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 225.0 indicates accelerating demand-side inflation, prompting central banks to raise rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in inflation acceleration periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 220.0 signals deflationary pressure, prompting central banks to hold rates steady, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in deflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
